desc: Implement `check(T)` in O(n): c[i]=ceil(T/points[i]); suffix MWIS DP (G0,G1) over weights B[i]=max(0,c[i]); prefix MWIS DP (F0,F1) over weights A[i]=max(0,c[i]-1); for each end E in 0..n-1 compute mw=max(F0+max(G0[E+1],G1[E+1]), F1+G0[E+1]) and moves=2*mw+E+1; return True if any moves<=m.
Binary search largest feasible T in [0, min(points)*((m+1)//2)] using monotone `check(T)`; verified on both provided examples (n=2 -> 4, n=3 -> 2).
Brute-force walk simulator cross-checked against the solution on both provided examples plus 200+ random small inputs: all passed, no counterexamples (SAMPLE TESTS verdict: PASS).
Confirm complexity O(n log(maxT)) with ~50 iterations and O(n) space for n up to 5e4.
